_about: Queue for `enrich waitlist` (enrich skill §1, references/waitlist.md). Built 2026-09-28 from a gap scan of the universe. The user pre-approved every company here as a new node (2026-09-28); nothing is applied until `enrich waitlist` runs. Excluded by rule: facility contractors (United Integrated Services, Acter, Marketech, Hanyang Eng).

groups.clear: Well-sourced gap found in the 2026-09-28 scan.
groups.affiliate: Separately listed affiliate/subsidiary of an existing node — user: add as its own node.
groups.low_ai_share: Large company, AI/this product is a small share of revenue — user: add anyway.
groups.kr_early: Korean small cap, sampling/pre-volume or customer undisclosed — user: add now.
groups.weak_evidence: Evidence is theme lists / blogs / rumor — user: add; the enrich run must look for a primary source.
groups.unnamed_tenant: Tenant or customer undisclosed / core business elsewhere — user: add anyway.
